about_the_game:
An Epic Soundtrack

With music ranging from Euro-trance to classical, the soundtrack has been carefully crafted to fit every situation from the most dire to the most emotional. Get lost in swirling strings or a thumping synth bass. Listen to the soundtrack on its own to reminisce of the adventures of We Only Come Out at Night: Gob's sunset, Claude's parents, the peace of the chapel, the fear of the Underworld.

Composed and performed by Roland Zimmerman

"Little Fugue" by J. S. Bach
